item.title: UFO location and alien encounter walkthrough in GTA 6
item.description: The Grand Theft Auto 6 UFO alien abduction encounter is the beginning of a very peculiar optional mission, which will eventually have you gallivanting all of Leonida in search of a mysterious building. It all starts when you investigate an abandoned car at the side of the road, but this can happen in multiple different locations, so you need to know where to go, and where to find the building shown to you in a dream after that.

item.title: 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' Star Reveals His 5 Favorite Episodes
item.description: Almost three decades after the show first debuted, Marsters remains one of the best parts of any Buffy rewatch. So when I got him on the phone recently to reflect on the show's fan-favorite musical episode , I took the chance to ask the Spike actor for his five favorite episodes of all time.

item.title: Steam's Black Friday Sale Is Here With Some Great PC Gaming Steals
item.description: Valve is known for its seasonal sales, so, of course, the PC gaming giant has cooked up some good deals for the day after Thanksgiving. Here are some of the best Steam promotions to look out for, from major releases to smaller indie games you might've missed.

item.title: All Randy's wish list car locations in GTA 6
item.description: Completing Randy's wish list in Grand Theft Auto 6 is challenging; you'll have to find rare luxury cars around Leonida, steal them, drive all the way back to Randy's with the police on your heels, and (ideally) do it all without damaging the car. With a total of 19 cars on Randy's list, this is one of the most daunting side missions.

item.title: Pokémon Officially Sets 2027 Anime Comeback to Launch With Winds and Waves
item.description: Pokémon Horizons , the latest iteration of the beloved franchise's animated series, is set to conclude its current "Wonders Ahead" arc before the end of the year. But before the final episode has even aired, The Pokémon Company has announced that a new season will premiere next year alongside the release of Winds and Waves , the next mainline games in the series.

item.title: How to unlock hurricanes in GTA 6
item.description: To unlock hurricanes in Grand Theft Auto 6 , you must find and befriend Freddie, a prepper (and rapper) living in a hidden bunker. Complete Freddie's side mission, and the weather is sure to turn foul, though your chances of witnessing a hurricane first-hand depend on the mission's final choice.

item.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Team Officially Confirms Sea of Sorrow DLC Release Date
item.description: It’s time for more bug-themed suffering. Hollow Knight: Silksong — Sea of Sorrow , the first DLC for last year’s megahit Metroidvania, will be released in December, developer Team Cherry announced Friday during its Cherry Time! games showcase. Given how long it took for Silksong — a game that was originally supposed to be an add-on — to come out, many fans are likely breathing a sigh of relief. The high-seas adventure-themed DLC was first teased last December .

item.title: Why Critical Role's Shorter Episodes Are Officially Here to Stay
item.description: Critical Role is by far the most popular Dungeons & Dragons actual-play show, with more than a decade of role-playing antics including one-shots, live shows, and hundreds of hours of tabletop campaigns. Its adventures are so beloved that the company has even adapted them into the Prime video animated series The Legend of Vox Machina and The Mighty Nein .

item.title: Nintendo Officially Launches Black Friday Deals on Switch 2 and Games
item.description: Nintendo has officially launched its Black Friday 2026 deals , giving frugal holiday shoppers an opportunity to get a pair of Nintendo Switch 2 system bundles at a discount. Nintendo is also putting select digital and physical games for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on sale, with discounts on games such as Super Mario Party Jamboree and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond .
